#kendall correlation analysis
```{r kendall-correlation}
name_map <- c(
  azimuth           = "Azimuth MMC",
  pbmc              = "PBMC",
  pollen            = "Pollen.",
  subsetbraindata   = "Human Primary Motor Cortex",
  tabulamurisliver  = "Tabula Muris Liver",
  tabulamurislung   = "Tabula Muris Lung"
)

datasets <- names(name_map)

results_list <- lapply(datasets, function(nm) {
  obj <- get(nm)
  
  test <- cor.test(obj$PPS_rank, obj$HVG_rank, method = "kendall")
  
  data.frame(
    dataset_name = name_map[[nm]],
    tau = unname(test$estimate),
    pvalue = test$p.value
  )
})

kendall_results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
kendall_results

write.csv(kendall_results, paste0(here(), "/Statistical_Tests/Kendall_Correlation.csv"))
```

#plotting and saving helpers
```{r plot-helpers}
library(ggplot2)

boxplot_width  <- 7.5
boxplot_height <- 5.25

# Save a plot as both TIFF and JPEG
save_plot_tif_jpg <- function(plot, file_stem, width = 5, height = 4) {
  ggsave(filename = paste0(file_stem, ".tif"),
         plot = plot,
         dpi = 300,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in",
         device = "tiff",
         compression = "lzw",
         type = "cairo",
         bg = "white")
  ggsave(filename = paste0(file_stem, ".jpg"),
         plot = plot,
         dpi = 300,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in",
         device = "jpeg",
         quality = 100,
         type = "cairo",
         bg = "white")
}

# Compute log2 mean expression & variance for a gene set in a given count matrix
get_gene_stats <- function(genes, count_matrix) {
  count_matrix <- log2(count_matrix + 1)
  genes <- gsub("-", "_", genes)              # match naming convention used on count matrices
  genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(count_matrix))
  mat <- count_matrix[genes, , drop = FALSE]
  data.frame(
    gene = genes,
    mean_expression = rowMeans(mat),
    variance = apply(mat, 1, var)
  )
}

make_gene_set_boxplot <- function(df, y_var, show_legend = TRUE,
                                  y_label = c(mean_expression = "Mean log2 expression",
                                              variance        = "Variance of log2 expression")[[y_var]]) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Category, y = .data[[y_var]], fill = Category)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ dataset, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = y_label,
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      breaks = c("Principal Genes", "HVGs"),
      values = c(
        "Principal Genes" = "#1BB7D8",
        "HVGs"            = "#E55B1E"
      )
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "right" else "none"
    )
}
```

#expression and variance boxplots
```{r expression-boxplots, fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 5.25}
# Principal Genes (top 100 PPS-ranked genes)
azimuth_pg <- get_gene_stats(rownames(azimuth), azimuth_count)
azimuth_pg$dataset <- "Azimuth MMC"

pbmc_pg <- get_gene_stats(rownames(pbmc), pbmc_count)

brain_pg <- get_gene_stats(rownames(subsetbraindata), brain_count)

lung_pg$dataset <- "Tabula Muris Lung"

principal_genes_df <- do.call(rbind, list(azimuth_pg, pbmc_pg, pollen_pg, brain_pg, liver_pg, lung_pg))

#HVGs (top 100 by dispersion)
azimuth_hvg <- get_gene_stats(azimuth_hvgs, azimuth_count)

#Combine & plot

mean_expr_plot

                  paste0(here(), "/Statistical_Tests/Log2v2Mean_Expression_HVG_vs_PG_boxplot_bydataset"),
                  width = boxplot_width, height = boxplot_height)
```

#read in unlabeled counts and perform HVG
```{r read-in-unlabeled-counts}
library(Seurat)

#Same preprocessing as the labeled datasets
read_counts <- function(path) {
  counts <- read.csv(path, row.names = 1)
  rownames(counts) <- gsub("-", "_", rownames(counts))
  colnames(counts) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(counts))
  counts
}

#Same HVG method as the labeled datasets (dispersion, all genes ranked, top 100 kept)
get_top_hvgs <- function(counts, n = 100) {
  so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = as.matrix(counts))
  so <- NormalizeData(so)
  so <- FindVariableFeatures(so, selection.method = "dispersion", nfeatures = nrow(counts))
  hvgs <- gsub("-", "_", VariableFeatures(so))
  hvgs[1:n]
}

crc_count        <- read_counts(paste0(here(), "/Filtered_Input/Human_CRC_subset_counts.csv"))          
intestines_count <- read_counts(paste0(here(), "/Filtered_Input/Human_Intestines_subset_counts.csv"))   
mouseheart_count <- read_counts(paste0(here(), "/Filtered_Input/Mouse_Heart_subset_counts.csv"))        
pbmcab_count     <- read_counts(paste0(here(), "/Filtered_Input/PBMC_antibody_gene_counts.csv"))  

crc_hvgs        <- get_top_hvgs(crc_count)
intestines_hvgs <- get_top_hvgs(intestines_count)
mouseheart_hvgs <- get_top_hvgs(mouseheart_count)
pbmcab_hvgs     <- get_top_hvgs(pbmcab_count)
```

#unlabeled expression and variance boxplots
```{r unlabeled-expression-boxplots, fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 5.25}
unlabeled_sets <- list(
  "Human CRC"        = list(pg = rownames(crc),        hvg = crc_hvgs,        counts = crc_count),
  "Human Intestines" = list(pg = rownames(intestines), hvg = intestines_hvgs, counts = intestines_count),
  "Mouse Heart"      = list(pg = rownames(mouseheart), hvg = mouseheart_hvgs, counts = mouseheart_count),
  "PBMC Antibody"    = list(pg = rownames(pbmcab),     hvg = pbmcab_hvgs,     counts = pbmcab_count)
)

unlabeled_stats <- lapply(names(unlabeled_sets), function(ds) {
  s <- unlabeled_sets[[ds]]
  pg  <- get_gene_stats(s$pg,  s$counts); pg$dataset  <- ds; pg$Category  <- "Principal Genes"
  hvg <- get_gene_stats(s$hvg, s$counts); hvg$dataset <- ds; hvg$Category <- "HVGs"
  rbind(pg, hvg)
})

unlabeled_boxplot_df <- do.call(rbind, unlabeled_stats)
unlabeled_boxplot_df$Category <- factor(unlabeled_boxplot_df$Category,
                                         levels = c("Principal Genes", "HVGs"))
unlabeled_boxplot_df$dataset <- factor(unlabeled_boxplot_df$dataset,
                                        levels = names(unlabeled_sets))  # keep facet order as listed

# Plot 1: mean expression (no legend)
unlabeled_mean_plot <- make_gene_set_boxplot(unlabeled_boxplot_df, "mean_expression", show_legend = FALSE)
unlabeled_mean_plot
save_plot_tif_jpg(unlabeled_mean_plot,
                  paste0(here(), "/Statistical_Tests/Log2v2Mean_Expression_HVG_vs_PG_boxplot_unlabeled"),
                  width = boxplot_width, height = boxplot_height)

# Plot 2: variance
unlabeled_variance_plot <- make_gene_set_boxplot(unlabeled_boxplot_df, "variance", show_legend = TRUE)
unlabeled_variance_plot
save_plot_tif_jpg(unlabeled_variance_plot,
                  paste0(here(), "/Statistical_Tests/Log2v2Variance_HVG_vs_PG_boxplot_unlabeled"),
                  width = boxplot_width, height = boxplot_height)

unlabeled_boxplot_df$gene <- NULL
write.csv(unlabeled_boxplot_df, paste0(here(), "/Statistical_Tests/log2_mean_expression_variance_all_unlabeled_datasets.csv"))
```

#unlabeled kendall correlation analysis
```{r kendall-correlation-unlabeled}
unlabeled_name_map <- c(
  crc        = "Human CRC",
  intestines = "Human Intestines",
  mouseheart = "Mouse Heart",
  pbmcab     = "PBMC Antibody"
)

unlabeled_results_list <- lapply(names(unlabeled_name_map), function(nm) {
  obj <- get(nm)
  
  # Convert GPS score to rank (same approach as the labeled datasets)
  obj$PPS_score_percent <- 1:100
  names(obj)[names(obj) == "GPS_score_percent"] <- "GPS_rank"
  
  test <- cor.test(obj$PPS_rank, obj$HVG_rank, method = "kendall")
  
  data.frame(
    dataset_name = unlabeled_name_map[[nm]],
    tau = unname(test$estimate),
    pvalue = test$p.value
  )
})

kendall_results_unlabeled <- do.call(rbind, unlabeled_results_list)
kendall_results_unlabeled

write.csv(kendall_results_unlabeled, paste0(here(), "/Statistical_Tests/Kendall_Correlation_Unlabeled.csv"))
```
